title: Utility Meets Privacy: A Critical Evaluation of Tabular Data Synthesizers
summary: Supplementary code for a paper benchmarking twelve tabular data synthesizers across seventeen medical datasets on a joint utility-privacy score. Its methods/sdv/sdv.py wrapper runs SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, and GaussianCopulaSynthesizer (built on SingleTableMetadata) as three of the compared synthesis methods.
evidence: methods/sdv/sdv.py:54-66 instantiates and fits CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata
needs: The methods/sdv directory is a thin wrapper script, not a vendored copy of the SDV library; confirmed as api_user rather than vendored_source.
